# Dive Bar Finder

> Dive Bar Finder is an independent iPhone app for discovering dive bars, punk bars, goth bars, rock bars, metal bars and alternative nightlife nearby.

Official website: https://divebarfinder.info/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/dive-bar-finder/id6758267440
Publisher: Fear Army LTD

## Main pages

- [About Dive Bar Finder](https://divebarfinder.info/about.html): Product purpose, editorial method and limitations.
- [World city guides](https://divebarfinder.info/guides/cities.html): Neighbourhood-first nightlife guides for sixteen cities.
- [Support](https://divebarfinder.info/support.html): App help and contact information.
- [For bars and venues](https://divebarfinder.info/venues.html): Listing corrections, venue suggestions and guide-linking information.
- [Privacy policy](https://divebarfinder.info/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://divebarfinder.info/terms.html)

## Editorial notes

Guides distinguish permanent bars from ticketed venues and recurring event nights. Venue details, opening hours, programmes, accessibility and admission rules can change. Time-sensitive information should be checked with the venue before travelling.

Listings are not paid rankings or certifications. Corrections and venue suggestions are reviewed against current public evidence.
